description: This file contains unit tests for the Order entity's total calculation within the eShopOnWeb application, verifying total price computations with different item configurations.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for verifying the total calculation of orders.

methods.name: IsZeroForNewOrder
methods.description: Tests that a new order with no items has a total of zero.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven1Item
methods.description: Tests that an order with a single item has the correct total equal to the unit price of that item.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven3Items
methods.description: Tests that an order with multiple items calculates the total correctly based on default values.
